decisions.summary: Preserve commitments while restricting publication to nondependent pending proposals.
decisions.concern: Can source dates become active commitments while legal authority is blocked?
options: Retain source proposals as tentative internal follow-up and withhold statutory commitments
decisions.chosen_behavior: Eight existing nondependent operational proposals receive tentative events; one undated authority-recovery action has no event. All requests remain pending and unsent.
decisions.rationale: Calendar actions can collect facts, check internal controls and prepare review without deciding statutory applicability. Policy reserves approval and activation to humans.
tradeoffs: Historical dates remain elapsed at retrieval; the calendar is a retrospective draft, not an active compliance schedule.
decisions.downstream_effect: Final CSV, brief, calendar and detached request bindings agree on actions, dates and pending authority.
